supersedes.legacy_use: regression replay of the 43 frozen P2 rows only; never used for a corrected verdict

G0.name: nominal_per_stream_30fps
G0.condition: per_stream_capacity_MBps >= demand_per_stream_MBps at the row fps
G0.note: 0% is an arithmetic control; the project gate is G25

G25.name: design_margin_25
G25.condition: per_stream_capacity_MBps >= 1.25 * demand_per_stream_MBps at the row fps
G25.note: frozen; never relaxed for any row, anchor or recommendation

grid.row_count_note: identical grid and order to the frozen P2 43-row grid (dedupe of 1080p30@187.5 c2s2 and c1s2); the row set is kept so that the legacy replay is a pure rules/input change, not a grid change

row_verdict_rules.condition: marginal_eram_total > 300 (resource cannot fit even in the expected column)
G0 missed (per-stream chain capacity < demand at the row fps)
cores == 2 (Routed dual-core timing unproven and shared-PAXI arbitration unproven)
G0 met and G25 missed (0 <= margin_0 < 25%)
row_verdict_rules.note: below_25 must NEVER be written as infeasible (this is the P2 GATE_COLLAPSE error)

row_verdict_rules.condition: G25 met but conservative ERAM > 270 or timing unproven
G25 met AND conservative ERAM <= 270 AND timing proven (single core at <=187.5 MHz only)
row_verdict_rules.note: row verdict is content-basis-local; the claim_status column and the headline carry the content envelope

claim_status.rule: the content envelope is a claim-level attribute separate from the row verdict; a row may not convert its claim_status into a different row verdict and a row verdict may not be used to upgrade the claim_status

assignment.1080p_rows: not_proven_all_content (chain anchor A1 is measured on ONE gradient content class only; A2 comp extrapolation crosses G0 and G25, so the content envelope is unproven)
assignment.affine_comp_rows: not_proven_all_content (chain anchor is an assumed comp area-scaling; no full-frame comp measurement exists)

claim_status.emitted_values_note: proven_for_measured_content is never emitted in r0 because no row has a measured full-frame chain anchor across more than one content class; the enum value is kept for future measured multi-class evidence

headline_rules_1080p30.scope: claim-level conclusion for per-stream 1080p30; reported as three parts G0 / G25 / content, never as one word

table.condition: A1.G0 == A2.G0 == true AND (A1.G25 == false OR A2.G25 == false OR resources/timing unproven)
table.headline: conditional

table.condition: A1.G0/G25 and A2.G0/G25 all true AND resources/timing proven
table.headline: feasible

headline_rules_1080p30.dual_core_cap: for any dual-core combination the headline can be at most not_proven (per-stream capacity is assumed_from_single_core and shared PAXI is unproven); dual-core feasible is forbidden

current.headline: not_proven
current.why: content crossing: the measured gradient passes both gates, the conservative comp extrapolation fails both; neither infeasible nor feasible is a defensible single word

per_stream_capacity.1core_2streams: C/2 (frame-level round robin; long-run 50% per stream)
per_stream_capacity.2core_2streams: C (one frozen core per stream; NEVER 2C)

chain_anchor_by_geometry.1920x1080: A1_grad_ss (measured); clock scaling only, cycle count is clock independent

capacity_rules.core_basis: comp fixed vector (slowest measured core content); rand only as an optimistic envelope
capacity_rules.aggregate_2c: may be used for DDR/total-volume statements only; never for a per-stream verdict

A2.label: assumed
A2.use: conservative content envelope; circular with A4 via the overhead definition (must be disclosed)

A3.label: assumed
A3.use: optimistic content envelope; never the worst case

A4.label: measured_but_not_throughput
A4.use: latency reference only; a cold single-frame completion time is not a frame interval

overhead_rules.shift_1080p: cycles_chain_1080p(tier) = S_ss + (tier - 426385); tier0 -> S_ss - 426385, primary -> S_ss, 1e6 -> S_ss + 573615
overhead_rules.applies: 1080p participates in the sensitivity (applies=true in all tiers); the P2 applies=false is superseded
overhead_rules.robust_definition: a geometry is tier-robust only if per-stream G25 is met in ALL three tiers
overhead_rules.optimization_path_rule: delta_req = S_ss - 5,000,000 cycles; if delta_req <= 426385 then reducing per-frame fixed overhead to <= (426385 - delta_req) is a sufficient path to G25; otherwise overhead alone cannot close the gap

ddr_rules.peak_fallback_basis: 1600 MT/s * 32 bit / 8 (rollback tier, disclosed, not current mainline)
ddr_rules.rule: a 1333 platform must not quote the 6,400 peak as the primary efficiency basis without a label; average inside peak does not prove sustained bandwidth or arbitration
ddr_rules.doc1_section8: the doc's 1.2/2.33/3.4 GB/s is not reproducible from data_rate*width/8; disclose, never adopt

uart_rules.rule: the steady-state export tail is a constant per-frame cost that cancels in the frame-to-frame interval; it is NOT subtracted from S_ss unless sink_limited (tail growing with k, or >= 0.5 * S_ss). A real 115200 UART cannot sustain 1080p30; the transport is not_proven and the sim sink must never be presented as a production path

forbidden: aggregate 2C compared against 155.52 MB/s to declare dual-stream feasibility

recommendation_rules.primary: largest per-stream pixel count at 30 fps that meets G25 at the primary overhead tier with resources/timing admissible, on the SAME content basis as the comparison set (comp-affine). A1-measured 1080p may only become the primary if A2 also meets G25
recommendation_rules.content_basis_consistency: the primary recommendation must not be a single-content measured anchor when all other candidates are comp extrapolations; 1080p30 is therefore reported on its own line as measured-content-only / not_proven_all_content

alternates.alt1: largest 30 fps single-core/single-stream comp-basis row meeting G25 in ALL three overhead tiers (tier-robust)
alternates.alt2: largest 1-core/2-stream row meeting G25 per stream in ALL three tiers

recommendation_rules.nominal_only: a row meeting G0 but not G25 is listed as nominal-only and may never be the primary recommendation
forbidden: primary justified by A1 while A2 fails G25
claiming tier robustness when any tier misses G25

frontier_rules.maximality: no 30 fps row with more pixels may meet G25 at the primary tier than the primary recommendation
frontier_rules.same_source: each frontier row's margin columns must come from the same anchor it names
frontier_rules.worst_tier: worst_tier_margin_pct = min over the three overhead tiers

negative_controls.name: cold latency used as steady-state throughput
sim fast sink presented as a production transport
